operation.summary: Verify a supported device with authorized credentials and enroll it for this agent

body.name: adapter
body.description: A built-in adapter (shelly_gen1, openwrt_ubus, tapo_onvif) or a device pack id from GET /v1/lan/packs, e.g. upnp_av for speakers; packs download on first use

body.name: talk_cloud_password
body.description: Optional separate authorized Tapo cloud password, encrypted privately; passive authentication only, no speaker playback

body.name: allow_http
body.description: Explicitly permit unencrypted LAN HTTP, including supplied credentials. Default false (HTTPS with normal certificate validation). Required for Tapo ONVIF.

operation.returns: Verified enrolled device and safe verification; saved only after successful protocol check. Tapo camera also appears in Devices tab, requiring existing lan_camera permission.

adapter.description: A built-in adapter (shelly_gen1, openwrt_ubus, tapo_onvif) or a device pack id from GET /v1/lan/packs, e.g. upnp_av for speakers; packs download on first use

talk_cloud_password.description: Optional separate authorized Tapo cloud password, encrypted privately; passive authentication only, no speaker playback

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

allow_http.description: Explicitly permit unencrypted LAN HTTP, including supplied credentials. Default false (HTTPS with normal certificate validation). Required for Tapo ONVIF.
